Applies request-scoped external findings before output rendering

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var inputJson = "{\"bytes\":[116,111,107,101,110,45,55,52,50,57,32,101,109,97,105,108,101,100,32,97,108,105,99,101,64,101,120,97,109,112,108,101,46,99,111,109,46],\"filename\":\"external-findings.txt\",\"kind\":\"bytes\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\"}";
        var input = JsonUtil.fromJson(inputJson, ExtractInput.class);
        var configJson = "{}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ExtractionConfig.class);
        var result = Xberg.extractWithExternalRedaction(input, config, java.util.Arrays.asList(JsonUtil.fromJson("{\"label\":\"inspection_token\",\"score\":0.99,\"text\":\"token-7429\"}", ExternalRedactionFinding.class)), "unicode_code_points", 8);
        System.out.println(result.results().get(0).content());
    }
}
```
